answer: Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 9 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 460 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The umber test is the live device, the inlet test is the locked stake, and the tundra test is the graded history no template can fake.
